mapper.select: SELECT USERNAME FROM HDOC_USER_INFOR WHERE USERID = #{userid}

SELECT ma.MARKET AS market, ma.TYPE AS type, ma.BU AS bu FROM HDOC_MARKET_AUTH ma WHERE ma.USERID = #{userid} AND ma.`TYPE` IN ( SELECT CASE fa.`FUNCTION` WHEN 'USER' THEN 'U' WHEN 'RULES' THEN 'R' WHEN 'TEMPLATE' THEN 'T' WHEN 'Document' THEN 'D' WHEN 'User Administrator' THEN 'A' WHEN 'ADAPTATION DOC' THEN 'DOCMOD' WHEN 'market super user' THEN 'MCSU' ELSE fa.`FUNCTION` END FROM HDOC_FUNCTION_AUTH fa WHERE fa.USERID = #{userid} ) UNION
SELECT '' AS market, CASE fa.`FUNCTION` WHEN 'USER' THEN 'U' WHEN 'RULES' THEN 'R' WHEN 'TEMPLATE' THEN 'T' WHEN 'Document' THEN 'D' WHEN 'User Administrator' THEN 'A' WHEN 'ADAPTATION DOC' THEN 'DOCMOD' WHEN 'market super user' THEN 'MCSU' ELSE fa.`FUNCTION` END AS type, '' AS bu FROM HDOC_FUNCTION_AUTH fa WHERE fa.USERID = #{userid} AND CASE fa.`FUNCTION` WHEN 'USER' THEN 'U' WHEN 'RULES' THEN 'R' WHEN 'TEMPLATE' THEN 'T' WHEN 'Document' THEN 'D' WHEN 'User Administrator' THEN 'A' WHEN 'ADAPTATION DOC' THEN 'DOCMOD' WHEN 'market super user' THEN 'MCSU' ELSE fa.`FUNCTION` END NOT IN ( SELECT TYPE FROM HDOC_MARKET_AUTH WHERE USERID = #{userid} )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO HDOC_FUNCTION_AUTH (USERID, `FUNCTION`, REGISTER_DATETIME, REGISTER_USER, REGISTER_PROCESS, UPDATE_DATETIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_PROCESS) VALUES (#{userid}, #{function}, NOW(), #{registerUser}, #{registerProcess}, NOW(), #{updateUser}, #{updateProcess})

INSERT INTO HDOC_MARKET_AUTH (USERID, MARKET, TYPE, BU, REGISTER_DATETIME, REGISTER_USER, REGISTER_PROCESS, UPDATE_DATETIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_PROCESS) VALUES (#{userid}, #{market}, #{function}, 'BU', NOW(), #{registerUser}, #{registerProcess}, NOW(), #{updateUser}, #{updateProcess})
